source.policy: Source item inventory retained; printed codes are references only. Internal product codes and SKUs are generated by RS Prints.

rules: Every source item must map to exactly one product model or one option value/variant under a product model.
Only create variant combinations explicitly supported by source or confirmed by owner.
Never create full Cartesian combinations by default.
Do not invent price, stock or availability.
Keep uncertain mappings in review list.
Keep existing Vendure collection hierarchy; do not recreate collections.
A model with more than one option group must provide an explicit variantCombinations array before any variants are generated.
Do not assume all values across multiple option groups are mutually compatible.
Apparel sizes and physical diameters are separate option groups; never mix clothing sizes with measurements.

reviewQueue.reason: Confirm whether the two pictured body styles correspond exactly to glossy and matte.
Source confirms black cotton and white cotton sizes. White polyester is shown but its size availability is unclear. Generate only source-supported combinations, not the full Cartesian product.
PDF size labels are visually unclear; verify before creating size variants.
Shape-to-code mapping follows the visual order on page 9; verify high-resolution source before publishing.
Confirm whether both square pillow products have the same dimensions and fur construction.
A084 appears to be a phone stand shown in two visual presentations. Confirm whether these are colour/finish variants or the same stand photographed twice.
A135 and A136 appear to be two different kids bottle models; inspect exact swatches and decide whether colour options belong within each model.
A115 and A116 differ by clear/frosted body and handle colours. Need confirm valid pairings before creating variants.
A141/A121/A142 differ by frosting and lid type; don't merge until model relationship is confirmed.
A051 visual shows multiple shapes/backings; determine whether those are variants or separate products.
MDF collage frames have many distinct designs and dimensions; treat as separate designs unless customer-selectable size options are confirmed.
BL-01 through BL-50 are distinct frame models/designs; A090 printed code collision needs source-reference-only handling.
A124 panel shows BB12 and BB32 at 600 ml under one printed code; determine if one product with model choice or two distinct product models.
